starter.name: Starter
starter.summary: Surrey + Victoria current rates, latest change diff (/changes); 5,000 requests/day.

pro.name: Pro
pro.summary: Everything in Starter + historical snapshots (?version=, explicit from/to versions); 50,000 requests/day.

how_to_upgrade: 1. Get a free key: POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/keys
2. POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/checkout with header X-API-Key and body {"plan": "starter"} or {"plan": "pro"}
3. Open the returned checkout_url and pay with Stripe Checkout.
4. Your SAME key is upgraded automatically (Stripe webhook). Check with GET /v1/account.
notes: Prices are monthly subscriptions billed by Stripe; cancel any time (plan reverts to free). Currency is whatever the operator set on the Stripe Price.
Victoria data is provisional (Wayback-sourced) on every plan.
